acceptance: floorStage and historyFloorStage share one projection helper, or comment_floor.stage moves to config.GateStageSetting so both keys read the same way.
The AGENTS.md caveat that a bad history_stage word fails closed while a bad comment_floor.stage word turns the floor off is removed once both keys behave the same.
fix: Give the two comment-floor stage keys one reading path.
summary: After the comment-history floor, floorStage and historyFloorStage repeat the same projection skeleton, and the two keys differ on a bad word: comment_floor.history_stage fails the policy closed to enforce while comment_floor.stage turns the floor off. title: The two comment-floor stage keys share one reader
